node.title: Re: Swiss army knife module for files?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I personally usually reach for [mod://Path::Class] and [mod://File::Find::Rule]. If for some reason I don't want to introduce extra dependencies (for example, I'm writing a module and I only need one of the features), then Perl's core File::* modules do just about everything I need: [doc://File::Spec::Functions], fileparse from [doc://File::Basename], [doc://File::Copy], [doc://File::Path], [doc://File::Temp], [doc://File::Find], and [doc://File::stat].
